description: Phase 4. The distributor's mutating operations, each one transaction prefixed by check_lock: (a) recruit for a demanded/uncovered tag - phase-a pipeline (Foreman new_worker with shard_id+idle params, lock at epoch, unlock at worker-reported durable version via typed pull_sources like bootstrap), then commit materializers/<tag> = {worker_id, node}; commit abort replaces the old delta-rejection as both the supersession signal (stop :normal) and the orphan-cleanup trigger. (b) heal on materializer death (monitor-driven, event-based like teamTracker; slow verify sweep as insurance): recruit replacement, commit the entry. With this, bootstrap stops creating data-tag workers (gaps left ABSENT; placeholder covers) - completing stall-only-for-tag-0. Proxies fold the committed mutations; displaced-but-alive workers still self-detect at the next push until phase 6 delivers in-band.
title: Recruit and heal transactions under the lock
